# truenas_replication_run (Action)

Runs a replication task now and waits for it to finish.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "truenas_replication_run" "archive" {
  config {
    id = truenas_replication.archive.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the replication task to run.
